map.由测得值与参考值求绝对偏倚: Find absolute bias from a measured value and a reference value
map.输入测得值与参考标准值，求绝对偏倚。: Enter a measured value and a reference standard value to get the absolute bias.
map.📖 查看「由测得值与参考值求绝对偏倚 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find absolute bias from a measured value and a reference value"
map.偏倚反映系统误差方向。: Bias reflects the direction of systematic error.
map.bias = mean(测量值) - 参考值（真值）。例：参考 10.000 m: bias = mean(measured values) - reference value (true value). Example: reference 10.000 mm, mean of 10 readings 10.015, bias = +0.015 mm.
map.Bias=x−x_ref=20.35−20=0.350。正值说明测量值系统性偏高: Bias = x - x_ref = 20.35 - 20 = 0.350. A positive value means the readings run systematically high, so when correcting you subtract this amount from later readings.
map.偏倚是重复测量的系统误差平均，反映量具整体偏移。: Bias is the averaged systematic error over repeated measurements and reflects the overall offset of the gage.
map.校准时减去偏倚或建立修正曲线使用。: Subtract the bias at calibration time, or build a correction curve and apply it.
